name: 91776 · San Gabriel, CA
findings: ZIP 91776 (San Gabriel) has 117 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91776 (San Gabriel) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 91776 (San Gabriel) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
